files.provenance: Extracted verbatim from lxml-6.1.3/doc/licenses/elementtree.txt in the SHA-256-verified lxml 6.1.3 source distribution. The source notice does not identify an ElementTree component version.

Copied verbatim from the installed canonical license text at /usr/share/common-licenses/LGPL-2.1. The canonical GNU URL timed out during retrieval on 2026-10-05. lxml 6.1.3 LICENSES.txt identifies the bundled iconv license as LGPL 2.1 but does not identify the bundled iconv version. Follow-up verification on 2026-10-05 during dev18 successfully retrieved the official GNU URL; its SHA-256 exactly matched this unchanged file. The license text alone does not establish corresponding-source or relinking compliance.

UTF-8 text extracted from the PRE block of the official zlib license page fetched on 2026-10-05, preserving the complete notice. The page identifies its notice source as zlib 1.3.2 (February 17, 2026); this is not evidence of the version bundled in lxml 6.1.3.
